rule: R7 (decisions 10.2): per public callable, judged from the skeleton docstrings only (what the coding models saw). value = the docstring determines the returned value for every contract-valid input; type = only the kind of value is promised; none = no return value is promised. Documented exceptions are always asserted. Missing callables default to type (recorded). A type level asserts the type family the reference returns, so it may be used only where the reference's return type agrees with the docstring; where it contradicts the docstring, use none.

notes.factorize: 'a tuple containing the two factors p and q': the order of p and q, and the result for an input that is not a product of two primes, are not specified. Not generated (pq has no generatable type), so no A2 test calls it; the level has no effect on H.

notes.__call__: 'a list with a string for each True bit': the docstring promises a list, but the reference returns None for 0 and a bare string for exactly one set bit (contract review note), so a type check would assert the reference's contradicting types; the order and the strings for unnamed bits are not specified either. Revised 2026-11-24 from type.
'Map an integer to the string representation': how *args/**kwargs define the mapping, and the result for an unmapped integer, are not specified.

notes.is_local_path: '判断是否为本地路径' (decide whether it is a local path): no rule says what a local path is.
notes.extract_local_paths: '从文本中提取本地文件路径' (extract local file paths from text): no rule for what counts as a path or where it ends.

notes.get_metadata: 'a dictionary containing the tool's metadata': the keys and their names are not specified.
notes.execute: no Returns section; the documented NotImplementedError is asserted (exceptions are always kept).
